notes: B0-01 through B0-05 implemented, including positive purchase/goods acceptance previously deferred from B0-02.

Exact user approval creates one durable Action; pre-send revalidation and reservation are lease-fenced. Unknown results preserve cash reservation and the store gate; reconciliation queries the original action before guaranteed-idempotent replay.

HTTP receipt and PURCHASE_ACCEPTED share one action-keyed ledger effect. Goods are bounded by confirmed quantity; missing receipts are fetched outside the atomic event transaction. Conflicts preserve evidence and raise ACTION_EXCEPTION without automatic financial overwrites.
Action-specific orphan recovery is implemented. Schedule remains disabled; recurring source/check/freshness dispatch and broader recovery/load acceptance remain B0-06/07.
Independent persistent simulator implements create/events/purchase/query/advance. Explicit full SC01 and API/worker/simulator restart smoke are recorded in b0-05-execution-smoke-result.json.
Supplier conflict evidence requires manual investigation; no automatic correction or administrative override API is provided. Controlled fault tests do not imply a deployed fault-injection endpoint.
